# garage_key (Data Source)

Look up a Garage access key by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_key" "app" {
  id = garage_key.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Access key ID.

### Read-Only

- `create_bucket` (Boolean) Whether this key is allowed to create buckets.
- `created` (String) Key creation timestamp.
- `expiration` (String) Expiration date (RFC 3339).
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the key has expired.
- `name` (String) Friendly name of the key.
